verdict.rationale: kitty exposes a remote-control API that agents can drive, so access control for that API is a fair axis. The pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for it. The probe's `allow_remote_control=socket-only` setting is an adjacent on/off transport control, not per-agent scoped credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
